name: Austria Parks Camping Leutasch - Seefeld
beschreibung: The campsite Austria Parks Camping Leutasch - Seefeld is located in the municipality of Leutasch in the Tiroler Oberland. The surroundings are characterized by the Karwendelgebirge and dense forests. Hiking trails and cycling trails are directly accessible from the site. In winter, the Seefeld ski areas and Rosshütte are nearby. The site offers a quiet, close-to-nature atmosphere. The facilities include sanitary facilities, a shop, and a playground. Guests have pitches for caravans, motorhomes, and tents. The season runs from May to October.
